subject: C6k: budget reclaim + memory tracing (ship-ready) and gated render-pass batching
body: SHIP-READY (budget): bridge code cache (<=8 MB, retained) is reclaimed and the allocation retried before any client/bridge allocation fails (current draw's code protected); n2mb_clear records failure sites; on rc=-15 and every TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED the frontend prints TEGU_GPU_MEMORY private/internal/code/imported KiB + BO count (n2mb_memory_stats) so the next log states where the 64 MiB went. Honest limit: 3 imported displays (33.7 MB) + CA full-screen private targets (11 MB each) leave little of 64 MiB; frontend cannot free CA's textures -> kernel 0086 (separate 128 MiB import budget) is the real fix. BATCHING (gated, default OFF; TEGU_JM_BATCH=1 or -DTEGU_JM_BATCH_DEFAULT): new n2mb_draw_batch chains up to 32 draws' MALLOC_VERTEX tiler jobs (+ one preload) into ONE frame / ONE fragment job (same layout the shipping LOAD preload already uses on hardware: command=frame+k*BLOCK sharing frame/tiler/TLS), largest prefix fitting 32 handles, exact pre-submit refusals -> per-draw fallback; excluded: fetch/target-sampled draws, MRT/MSAA/TLS, R8, mid-pass load!=1, mixed flat shading. Host: 200-draw CA command buffer under modelled 64 MiB: per-draw 212 GPU jobs vs batched 33, peak 46-47/64 MiB, status 4 both. Gates: run_host_tests PASS (new bridge tests: batching chain walk/indices/refusals; budget reclaim) except NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN; CA test 39 checks ASan+release; render harness PASS; integration 1005 + provenance PASS, only CA natural-stride oracle fails. Not committed.
